title: RHODES ISLAND ICEBREAKER GAMES #2 OPEN
lines: DETAILS: During the event, players can obtain [Participation Certificate - S2] by participating in coop event stages, completing Milestones and daily active missions, and raise [Hype] levels to receive rewards. Additionally, players can collect event group photos in the Photo Album to obtain rewards.
REWARDS: Whistlewind Series - One-man Racing Team for Chiave, Event Icon, Module Materials, Elite Materials, LMD, Battle Records, etc.
◆In Icebreaker Games#2, players can also directly invite friends to join the room and play together.

DETAILS: During the event, players can participate in Icebreaker Games #2, complete Limited-time Mission on the Icebreaker Goals board, and earn Icebreak Points to redeem rewards from Credit Milestones. Additionally, by inviting other players to form a team, you can earn extra points.
03 TARGETED OPERATOR HEADHUNTING OPEN: JOINT OPERATION
DETAILS: During the event, the Targeted Operator Headhunting, [Joint Operation], opens, and ONLY the following Operators will appear in the 6★ and 5★ Operator List of this Standard Headhunting:
★★★★★: Mitm / Wulfenite / Grain Buds / Lunacub / Santalla / Greyy the Lightningbearer
DETAILS: During the event, the following packs will be available from the Store for a limited time.
CONTENTS: Module Data Block * 24, Data Supplement Instrument * 30, Data Supplement Stick * 90
05 RE-EDITION OUTFITS AT THE OUTFIT STORE
DETAILS: The following Re-edition Outfits will be available at the Outfit Store, including:
Witch Feast Series - The Shadow of the Dark Moon for Degenbrecher
Witch Feast Series - Explosive Blue Flame for Blaze
Witch Feast Series - Starry Night Sky for Bassline
Witch Feast Series - Witch's Swing for Popukar
Witch Feast Series - Divine Oath for Fiammetta
Witch Feast Series - Hand of Destiny for Dorothy
Witch Feast Series - The Bard's Tale for Quercus
Witch Feast Series - Priory of Abyss for Whisperain

DETAILS: During the event, Special Recruitment will refresh the Job Tags that include the corresponding tags. Senior Operator tag is guaranteed to appear during event (once only). By completing the recruitment with the Senior Operator tag in this period, you can obtain one 5★ Operator (limited to Operators available from Recruit).

When the Top Operator tag is chosen and the recruitment time is set to 9 hours, a 6-star operator is guaranteed. When the Senior Operator tag is chosen, the Top Operator tag is excluded, and the recruitment time is set to 9 hours, a 5-star operator is guaranteed.
